title: B2B Sales Executive
description:
Greys Specialist Recruitment are recruiting for a B2 B Sales Executive to join an established and growing business with an expanding commercial team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing new business and identifying opportunities to generate revenue.

You'll be responsible for selling advertising solutions across print and digital platforms, working with businesses to understand their objectives and recommend solutions that deliver genuine value. Whether you have experience in media and advertising or a strong background in B2 B sales, this role offers the opportunity to develop your commercial career.

The Role

You'll take ownership of your own sales pipeline, combining new business development with account management to build lasting client relationships and maximise revenue opportunities.

From identifying prospective clients and making initial contact through to presenting proposals, negotiating and closing deals, you'll manage the full sales cycle and play an important role in the continued growth of the business.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and develop new business opportunities through prospecting, networking and cold calling.
- Build relationships with prospective and existing business clients.
- Understand client requirements and present relevant advertising solutions.
- Prepare proposals, negotiate commercial terms and close sales.
- Develop existing accounts and identify opportunities to generate additional revenue.
- Manage the full sales cycle, from initial contact through to completion.
- Maintain accurate CRM records and manage your sales pipeline effectively.
- Keep up to date with market trends and identify new commercial opportunities.
- Work towards and exceed individual sales targets.

About You

We're looking for a confident, commercially driven sales professional who enjoys speaking to people, spotting opportunities and converting conversations into business.

You'll ideally have previous B2 B sales experience, with backgrounds in advertising, media, publishing or other commercial sales environments particularly relevant. Most importantly, you'll be comfortable generating new business, managing client relationships and working towards targets.

You'll bring:
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive approach to prospecting and business development.
- Confidence negotiating and closing commercial opportunities.
- The ability to understand client needs and sell the benefits of a solution.
- Good organisation and the ability to manage multiple sales opportunities.
- A target-driven mindset and the motivation to achieve results.
- Confidence using CRM systems and sales technology.

What's on Offer?
- 30,000 basic salary.
- OTE of 40,000 to 45,000.
- The opportunity to join an established and growing business.
- A varied B2 B sales role combining new business development and account management.
- The opportunity to develop your sales skills and build a strong portfolio of business clients.

How to Apply

If you're an experienced B2 B sales professional looking for your next opportunity, contact David at Greys Specialist Recruitment to find out more.

title: Field New Sales Executive - Service. Lifts, Escalators
description:
Lift Maintenance Service Contracts New Business B2 B Field Sales

Sell a Service You Can Actually Stand Behind

Are you a lift industry salesperson who's at your best opening doors and winning new maintenance contracts, but tired of fighting process, paperwork and a service team that lets you down?

Liftec Express, a leading independent lift and escalator specialist, is growing its sales team. It's looking for a genuine new business hunter to build its lift maintenance portfolio across the Kent & Sussex territory.

No up-to-date CV? No problem. This starts with an informal & confidential chat with Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing.

The Role at a Glance:

New Business Sales Executive
Field-based: Kent & Sussex territory

£50,000 £65,000 Basic DOE + £10,000 £15,000 OTE Uncapped
Car allowance + business mileage reimbursed monthly + company mobile
Full-Time Permanent

Leadership: Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing - ex Otis, Schindler, Lift & Engineering Services

Company: Independent lift and escalator specialist in maintenance, repair, installation and modernisation. Formerly part of Otis, now Private Equity-backed by R Capital

Ambition: £100m turnover by 2035

Focus: New Business Lift Maintenance Contracts Long-Term Client Relationships

Values: Doing the Basics Brilliantly Extreme Ownership Customer at the Centre Honesty & Integrity

Who We Are

At Liftec Express, we keep people moving safely and reliably, while building a company our team is proud of and our customers trust.

Previously part of Otis, Liftec is now an independent business with a big ambition: to become a £100m turnover company by 2035. We'll get there by giving property managers, facilities managers, building owners and main contractors outstanding service from a responsive independent partner.

Why More Salespeople from competitors Are Joining

Less red tape, more selling. You won't spend your week chasing approvals. Our quoting system is slick, decision-makers are accessible, and our MD will look at non-standard terms when there's a good reason. One of our recent hires, who joined from a major OEM, says producing a quote, seeing a customer and getting terms approved is far easier here.

A service you won't have to apologise for. Too often in this industry, salespeople win a contract that the service team then can't deliver. Not here. We do proper maintenance visits of around 45 minutes, not a ten-minute box-tick. We make proactive recommendations, manage shutdowns properly and take every customer issue seriously. You'll never look foolish in front of a client because operations let you down.

A team, not a lone wolf. Big companies often leave their salespeople to fend for themselves. Here, the sales team works together and pulls in the same direction, with real support behind you.

Room to grow. As we scale toward £100m, the sales structure will grow with us, including future leadership roles. Lisa will coach and develop strong performers every step of the way.

Earnings that reward results. You'll get a competitive basic plus commission paid on every lift you bring on contract. The best-structured deals earn the most, and good salespeople can earn very well.

A Word from Lisa

"I joined Liftec because it's an ambitious business with huge potential. It's fast-paced with a great team around you and everyone genuinely wants to help. I felt at home very quickly. We're independent, growing rapidly and there's a real opportunity for good salespeople to come in, make their mark and be part of what we're building."

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. There's no inherited account book and no renewals. Your mission is to win new lift maintenance contracts across a patch with thousands of lifts in it.

You'll:
- Build and manage your own prospect pipeline
- Target decision-makers across property management, facilities, building ownership and main contractors
- Take opportunities from first contact through to signed contract
- Conduct site visits and consultative customer meetings
- Prepare proposals, presentations and commercial submissions
- Lead and complete tender submissions, including full commercial review
- Negotiate long-term maintenance agreements
- Keep your CRM pipeline and forecasting accurate
- Work with our operational teams to ensure a smooth handover once business is won

Lift service contracts are typically three years and are well written, so some opportunities mean keeping a prospect warm for the long haul. Others can be won quickly, and there are always one- and two-lift wins to be had. You'll need the drive of a hunter and the patience to build relationships over time.

About You

You'll already be selling lift service and maintenance contracts and know how the industry works. This role needs someone who can hit the ground running, so lift industry experience is essential.

You'll bring:
- A track record of winning new B2 B lift service & maintenance customers
- Strong prospecting and pipeline-building skills
- Consultative, relationship-led selling. SPIN-style approaches work really well here.
- The ability to understand customer pressure points and build trust over long sales cycles
- Strong commercial, negotiation and presentation skills
- Experience with proposals and tenders
- Good CRM and forecasting discipline
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel

Service sales here is about long-term relationships and understanding what keeps customers awake at night. It doesn't need the deep engineering expertise of modernisation sales. Our modernisation specialists work alongside you when those opportunities arise.

We're looking for people who are open-minded and inquisitive, take extreme ownership, put the customer at the centre and act with honesty and integrity. If that sounds like you, come and help us build what comes next.

Benefits:
- Competitive base salary
- Car allowance
- Pension from day one through Aviva
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Employee Assistance Programme from day one
- Death in Service cover at three times salary
- Discretionary sickness scheme
- Enhanced maternity and paternity provision, subject to service
- Employee discounts platform
- Employee referral scheme
- Role-dependent incentive scheme

Ready to Open Doors?

Not actively looking, but curious? Good. There's no need for an up-to-date CV. Start with an informal, confidential conversation, and if it feels right, have a chat with Lisa.

Bring the relationships. Build the pipeline. Win the contracts.

Application notice We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative

Job description

About Able Skills

Able Skills is one of the UK s leading construction training providers, helping thousands of individuals each year gain the practical skills and qualifications needed to build successful careers in the trades. From plumbing and electrical training to carpentry, gas, plastering and property maintenance courses, we provide hands-on training delivered by experienced industry professionals. Our mission is to bridge the skills gap within the construction industry by equipping learners with the knowledge, confidence and opportunities they need to succeed.

Job requirements

The Role

We are looking for an ambitious and driven sales development representative to join our growing team. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in growing our business. It could be your first graduate role post university but we are looking for a hungry, determined team player.

You will be responsible for growing both our B2 C offering and our B2 B offering. This will involve answering the phone to inbound requests, showing students and companies around the Site, targeting prospects and doing outbound emails and calls to try and help us to continue to grow through growing new business opportunities with construction companies, housebuilders, developers and other industry employers who are looking to hire skilled tradespeople.

Working closely with our sales team, you will be a face of the business, offering the opportunity to make a real impact on both our students careers and the wider construction industry.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will be highly organised, proactive and confident building relationships with both candidates and clients. They will thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and be motivated by helping people achieve their career goals.

Key requirements include:
- You will be based near our office in Dartford and happy to be in the office 5 days a week to show potential candidates and clients around the building
- 0-2 years sales experience or customer service experience, ideally within the construction, trades or built environment sectors.
- Ability to use our CRM system to log calls and follow up afterwards
- A mix of doing inbound calls, outbound calls, targeting and coming up with creative solutions to fill all of our different trades courses
- High level of resilience and tenacity to handle high quota of sales calls
- Understanding or hunger to learn about the different trade qualifications and courses we offer and an ability to sell the different offerings
- Confidence speaking on the phone and developing relationships with candidates and employers, including housebuilders, developers, contractors and construction businesses.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- A proactive, self-motivated approach with a willingness to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
- A passion for helping people develop and an enjoyment of showing people around our site
- Ability to work collaboratively as part of a growing, ambitious team.

Experience within trades sales would be highly advantageous, although candidates with a interest in the construction sector and sales will also be considered.
